GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Helps users find and reschedule flights using hardcoded demo flight data, tier status, and booking policies.

templateVersions.content:
The user has requested the following flight: {!$Input:New_Flight_Requested}
Customer Information: - Membership Tier: Gold - Previous Reservation Type: Choice
Available Flights (SEA to JFK):
Flight 1388: Departs 1:15 PM, Arrives 9:35 PM, Nonstop, 5h 20m Basic: $0, Choice: $0, Choice Preferred: $15, Choice Extra: $36
Flight 2104: Departs 4:45 PM, Arrives 1:05 AM+1, Nonstop, 5h 20m Basic: $0, Choice: $0, Choice Preferred: $25, Choice Extra: $45
Flight 3909: Departs 10:30 PM, Arrives 6:50 AM+1, Nonstop, 5h 20m (Fastest) Basic: $0, Choice: $0, Choice Preferred: $15, Choice Extra: $36
Booking Policies: - Gold tier members may rebook at no additional charge for same-day flights. - Choice fare bookings allow free rebooking up to 24 hours before departure. - Basic fare bookings have a $75 change fee. - All rebookings are subject to fare difference.
Instructions: 1. Confirm the user is eligible to rebook based on their tier and fare type using the policies above. 2. Present the available flight options with pricing. 3. If the user is not eligible, explain why based on the policies.
